notes.title: DEMO UPDATE – Celebrate the 50th Anniversary of Vietnam’s Reunification Day
notes.content:
I’m pleased to announce a permanent DEMO UPDATE on my Steam page in honour of the 50th anniversary of Vietnam’s Reunification Day—April 30, 1975 marked the fall of Saigon and the official end of the Vietnam War, a milestone of national unity and renewal. This update adds two exciting features that will remain available to all players:

[list]
[*] New Stage: “April30”
[*] New Program: “SpwnTank” (unlocked upon defeating the April30 stage)
[/list]
